exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.reason: Increases shoulder mobility and blood flow
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width and arms extended out to sides at shoulder height.
Make small forward circles, gradually increasing circle diameter.
Reverse direction after 15 seconds.
Finish with 10 backward shoulder rolls.
exercises.formTips: Warms up shoulder joint synovial fluid and rotator cuff tendons before pressing.
exercises.commonMistakes: Rushing through motion with stiff shoulders.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.reason: Primary compound lift for chest mass and strength
instructions: Lie flat on the bench with eyes directly beneath the bar. Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and hold it straight over your chest with arms locked.
Lower the bar with control to your mid-chest while tucking elbows at roughly 45-degrees.
Press the bar back up explosively until your arms are fully extended.
exercises.formTips: Retract and depress shoulder blades into the bench throughout the lift. Drive heels into the floor.
exercises.commonMistakes: Bouncing bar off the sternum, flaring elbows out to 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
exercises.reason: Builds deltoid size and stability

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
exercises.reason: Isolates lateral deltoids for width

exercises.name: Standing Tricep Extensions
exercises.reason: Targets tricep heads for arm thickness

exercises.name: Static Chest Stretch
exercises.reason: Promotes recovery and flexibility

exercises.name: Leg Swings
exercises.reason: Prepares hip joint for heavy lifting
instructions: Hold onto wall or rack for support.
Swing one leg forward and backward smoothly in fluid controlled pendulum motion.
Switch to swinging side-to-side across body.
Repeat on opposite leg.
exercises.formTips: Lubricates hip joints and dynamically stretches hamstrings and adductors.
exercises.commonMistakes: Swinging violently past comfortable stretch.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.reason: King of leg exercises for overall lower body mass
instructions: Rest barbell on upper traps. Set feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes turned outward.
Hinge hips backward, bend knees, and lower hips down as if sitting in a low chair.
Keep knees tracked with toes. Descend until thighs are parallel or below.
Drive upwards through heels, extending hips and knees back to stand.
exercises.formTips: Keep your chest tall and avoid letting your knees cave inward.
exercises.commonMistakes: Lifting heels off the floor, rounding lower back.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.reason: Targets posterior chain for balanced leg development

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunges
exercises.reason: Unilateral movement to fix imbalances and build quad size
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width. Step forward with one foot, lowering hips.
Bend both knees to 90 degrees with back knee hovering just above floor.
Drive off front foot to return to stand and step forward with other leg.
exercises.formTips: Keep front knee aligned directly over front ankle.
exercises.commonMistakes: Slamming back knee onto ground.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises
exercises.reason: High volume for calf hypertrophy
instructions: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart holding dumbbells by your sides.
Raise up onto the balls of your feet, contracting your calf muscles at the top.
Pause for a second at full contraction.
Slowly lower heels back down until you feel a gentle stretch in the calves.
exercises.formTips: Control the descent for 2 seconds to maximize calf stimulation.
exercises.commonMistakes: Bouncing up and down quickly without pausing.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch
exercises.reason: Reduces muscle tightness post-training

exercises.name: Band Pull-Aparts
exercises.reason: Activates rear delts and improves posture
instructions: Hold resistance band shoulder-width with straight arms at chest height.
Pull band apart by squeezing shoulder blades together until band touches chest.
Pause for 1 second, then slowly return.
exercises.secondary: Rear Delts, Rotator Cuff, Upper Back
exercises.formTips: Activates postural muscles and rear shoulders prior to upper body lifting.
exercises.commonMistakes: Shrugging shoulders into ears.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row

exercises.reason: Allows for greater range of motion and unilateral strength

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls
exercises.reason: Isolates biceps for arm definition
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended and palms forward.
Keep elbows close to your torso. Curl the weights upward by contracting your biceps.
Squeeze hard at the peak contraction.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to starting position under control.
exercises.formTips: Do not swing your back or hips to create momentum.
exercises.commonMistakes: Moving elbows forward during the curl.

exercises.name: Face Pulls (with Dumbbells)
exercises.reason: Promotes shoulder health and rear delt development

exercises.name: Back Stretch
exercises.reason: Relaxes latissimus dorsi and upper back muscles

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.reason: Increases shoulder mobility and blood flow
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width and arms extended out to sides at shoulder height.
Make small forward circles, gradually increasing circle diameter.
Reverse direction after 15 seconds.
Finish with 10 backward shoulder rolls.
exercises.formTips: Warms up shoulder joint synovial fluid and rotator cuff tendons before pressing.
exercises.commonMistakes: Rushing through motion with stiff shoulders.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.reason: Primary compound lift for chest mass and strength
instructions: Lie flat on the bench with eyes directly beneath the bar. Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and hold it straight over your chest with arms locked.
Lower the bar with control to your mid-chest while tucking elbows at roughly 45-degrees.
Press the bar back up explosively until your arms are fully extended.
exercises.formTips: Retract and depress shoulder blades into the bench throughout the lift. Drive heels into the floor.
exercises.commonMistakes: Bouncing bar off the sternum, flaring elbows out to 90 degrees.

exercises.reason: Builds deltoid size and stability

exercises.name: Leg Swings
exercises.reason: Prepares hip joint for heavy lifting
instructions: Hold onto wall or rack for support.
Swing one leg forward and backward smoothly in fluid controlled pendulum motion.
Switch to swinging side-to-side across body.
Repeat on opposite leg.
exercises.formTips: Lubricates hip joints and dynamically stretches hamstrings and adductors.
exercises.commonMistakes: Swinging violently past comfortable stretch.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.reason: King of leg exercises for overall lower body mass
instructions: Rest barbell on upper traps. Set feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes turned outward.
Hinge hips backward, bend knees, and lower hips down as if sitting in a low chair.
Keep knees tracked with toes. Descend until thighs are parallel or below.
Drive upwards through heels, extending hips and knees back to stand.
exercises.formTips: Keep your chest tall and avoid letting your knees cave inward.
exercises.commonMistakes: Lifting heels off the floor, rounding lower back.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.reason: Targets posterior chain for balanced leg development

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunges
exercises.reason: Unilateral movement to fix imbalances and build quad size
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width. Step forward with one foot, lowering hips.
Bend both knees to 90 degrees with back knee hovering just above floor.
Drive off front foot to return to stand and step forward with other leg.
exercises.formTips: Keep front knee aligned directly over front ankle.
exercises.commonMistakes: Slamming back knee onto ground.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises
exercises.reason: High volume for calf hypertrophy
instructions: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart holding dumbbells by your sides.
Raise up onto the balls of your feet, contracting your calf muscles at the top.
Pause for a second at full contraction.
Slowly lower heels back down until you feel a gentle stretch in the calves.
exercises.formTips: Control the descent for 2 seconds to maximize calf stimulation.
exercises.commonMistakes: Bouncing up and down quickly without pausing.
